name: Hybrid GDN + MHA
tagline: Three gated delta blocks, then one full-attention block.
description: A 24-layer, 1.399B-parameter hybrid repeating GDN, GDN, GDN, full causal MHA six times: 18 GDN layers and 6 MHA layers. The 3:1 layout follows Qwen3-Next, while the mixers and shared shell retain this repository's GDN and native MHA adaptations. Width is 1536, with 12 heads of dimension 128, FFN width 5760, vocabulary 32768, and a 2048-token context. Blocks have independent weights; this is not a recursive or weight-tied model.
paperTitle: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
mechanism: Full causal MHA at one-based layers 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, and 24, with 12 query and 12 KV heads; all other layers use GDN.

GDN uses input-dependent scalar decay per head, delta-rule correction, length-4 causal convolutions, L2-normalized q/k, sigmoid beta, and gated normalized output. The fla_chunk64 backend uses FLA's equivalent chunked KDA kernel with a broadcast per-head gate.

The native shell retains untied embeddings, ReLU-squared FFNs, RMSNorm, smear, backout, and learned residual/x0 coefficients. Native QK normalization and RoPE apply to MHA; VE is present at one-based even layers, including every MHA layer.
Packed rows use native BOS best-fit packing. GDN state resets at each row boundary, not at every BOS; causal attention may cross document boundaries inside a row.

Single-stage, from-scratch BF16 training uses the shared Muon+AdamW protocol: seed 42, 49.152B input tokens, 1,048,576 tokens per update, and 46,875 updates. CORE evaluates all 22 tasks at steps 8000, 16000, 24000, 32000, 40000, and 46875; periodic validation and independent final BPB remain separate.
limitations: A repository adaptation of the Qwen3-Next 3:1 layout, not a reproduction of its gated-attention, GQA, partial-RoPE, or MoE architecture, and not the Gated DeltaNet paper's H1/H2 hybrid. The completed 8 x B300 run used FLA for GDN and deterministic SDPA with FlashAttention disabled for MHA; do not infer FA throughput from this result. Theoretical training FLOPs include forward, backward, and optimizer work, not measured hardware speed. Single-seed 2K-context results do not establish statistical superiority, long-context quality, or inference memory/speed gains. BPB, CORE, hardware, and per-run provenance belong in the associated run record; this card alone does not establish a matched run or an accepted full-Dense comparison. Historical H100 numerical and throughput checks are available, but a separate 512-update pilot and target-B300 distributed/fresh-process resume acceptance have not been evidenced. The submitted run completed; final acceptance remains subject to maintainer review. The device reports NVIDIA B30Z; B300 is the owner-supplied hardware label.
